data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root ‘Abd’, meaning ‘to serve’. In Islamic context, the name Abd symbolizes one’s devotion and dedication to Allah. Historically, it has been used across various Muslim cultures to denote spiritual servitude and piety.
